title: Published snapshot is 246.9 h old and covers none of the open fixtures
detail: The published dashboard was generated 2026-10-15T08:36:13Z, 246.9 hours before this observation — outside the 8-hour bound the site itself publishes. 0 of the 14 currently open Hotspawn CS2 fixtures appear in it, so a reader opening the site now sees an old inventory. The served bytes are byte-identical (same SHA-256) to the checked-in branch-root data/latest.json generated 2026-10-15T08:36:13Z, which is the signature of the legacy Pages build republishing the branch root over the verified artifact — the race documented at length in .github/workflows/pages.yml.
